project.name: Throne Room Anime — Two Long Takes
project.description: 2 long clips with timestamp-annotated prompts for internal scene pacing

source.prompt: Anime scene in a candlelit throne room, portrait framing, anime art style with detailed cel-shading. [0:00] A stern bearded king in dark ornate robes over red garment sits rigidly, an advisor's hand gestures toward him from the right. [0:02] Cut to a concerned heavier advisor in dark patterned robes with gold trim, leaning forward with clasped hands. [0:04] The king's expression shifts to agitation, brow furrowing deeply. [0:06] A young servant with mustache and goatee in dark robes speaks seriously, warm amber candlelight throughout.

generate.prompt: Anime art style, detailed cel-shading with bold outlines, a stern-faced bearded man in dark ornate robes over red inner garment, hair in top knot with elaborate dark headpiece, sitting in a candlelit ornate throne room, a hand gesturing toward him from the right, warm amber lighting, medium close-up, portrait orientation

source.prompt: Anime scene continuing in candlelit throne room, portrait framing, anime art style with detailed cel-shading. [0:00] The determined king with small beard speaks forcefully, furrowed brow and tight lips, gesturing as he talks about barbarian states entering the capital. [0:03] A heavier advisor with clasped hands looks down with a serious worried expression. [0:05] The king's expression turns to outright fury, narrowed eyes and clenched jaw, speaking through gritted teeth about defending honor, dramatic candlelight shadows flicker across his face.
